title: Pacyniak Varian 21iX 16 MV 40x40 measured PDD (Figure 3 vector digitization)

measurement_contract.paper_statement: Figure 3 compares calculated and measured 16 MV PDD for 2x2, 10x10 and 40x40 cm2; paper reports ±2% agreement over 0–30 cm.

extraction_notes: Measured 40x40 curve extracted from the vector path embedded in Figure 3, not OCR/raster tracing. Values reproduce the plotted polyline at 1 cm depth intervals. Experimental measurement uncertainty is not tabulated in the source; no uncertainty was invented. SSD not asserted because it is not specified for this plotted dataset in the source passages used here.
